overview: Static variables, integer division, control flow, gcd loops, function calls; trace and print.
coreConcept: Program ko line-by-line trace karo, variable values table me likho.
hinglishExplanation: Static local variable calls ke beech value retain karta hai. Integer division truncate hota hai. Loop conditions ke off-by-one dhyan se dekho. Euclid-type loops (x-y) gcd dete hain.
formalDefinition: Program ko line-by-line trace karo, variable values table me likho.
